every irreducible W(2, 2)-module with a nontrivial weight space is a Harish-Chandra module.
all irreducible weight modules of W(2, 2), which have an infinite-dimensional weight space, are of intermediate series.
the classification of irreducible weight W(2, 2)-modules can be reduced to the classification of irreducibles of finite-dimensional Harish–Chandrasubalgebras.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of irreducible weight W(2, 2)-modules is much more complicated than that of W(2, n) modules for $n \geqslant 4$.
the classification of irreducible weight W(2, 2)-modules with an infinite dimensional weight spaces is a very hard problem.
